who_edits: A human, and only a human (CLAUDE.md rule 2). Agents and tools read this file and never write it. To record a decision: set its status to "decided", set value (and families, for promotion_population) to what was decided, and fill decided_by, decided_on (YYYY-MM-DD) and decision_ref (the HANDOFF section, gap answer or message the ruling is in), in a commit of its own whose message names the gap. docs/ledger-schema.md, section Promotion, says how the verdict reads this file.

promotion_population.question: Which val population do permutation_consistency and ood_abstain's in-distribution bound judge promotion on: every family pooled (as built), each family separately, or code.defect_class with the general families report-only?
promotion_population.value: code.defect_class: the defect family's val choice rows judge permutation_consistency and ood_abstain's in-distribution bound; every general family is report-only
promotion_population.source: the gates as built, not a ruling: tools/real_ft_run.py permutation_agreement and choice_rule_abstentions read every val choice row of every family; both were defined when val was code.defect_class only (gaps.jsonl, GAP-GATES-POOL-THE-GENERAL-FAMILIES-INTO-DEFECT-CONTRACTS, revised record)
promotion_population.decided_by: the human, by delegation ("For decisions ask fable and proceed with them", in the lead's session, 2026-10-03 ~13:14Z), through the lead, ruled by Fable
promotion_population.decision_ref: AUDIT/finalize-2026-10-03/fable-delegated-decisions-ruling.md (main b2ad747), ruling 2; the options and the counter-argument are in AUDIT/finalize-2026-10-03/promotion-decision-brief.md, row 1. Decided with v4's numbers in view. Pooled reading: permutation_consistency 93.2% (seed 0, f4feac15) and 93.7% (ens5, b45406b5) against a 95% floor; in-distribution abstentions 843 and 814 of 10,985 against a cap of 504. code.defect_class reading: 99.44% on both, and 13 of 2,304 abstentions on both (Wilson upper 0.0096). The suite half of ood_abstain is out-of-distribution by construction and does not change: 132/180 and 61/180 against 170. The rule takes effect only through code that reads this record (GAP-PROMOTION-RECORD-IS-NOT-APPLIED-BY-THE-GATES-2026-10-03).

average_may_promote.question: May an average of seeds' weights, scored as an 'avg' eval row, be the promoted artifact in place of its seeds?
average_may_promote.source: tools/real_ft_run.py AVERAGED_PROMOTION_NOTE (every averaged eval row says it does not make this decision); Fable F1 and D1-D3 in HANDOFF/gh200-phase4-2026-10-01.md
average_may_promote.decided_by: the human, by delegation ("For decisions ask fable and proceed with them", in the lead's session, 2026-10-03 ~13:14Z), through the lead, ruled by Fable
average_may_promote.decision_ref: AUDIT/finalize-2026-10-03/fable-delegated-decisions-ruling.md (main b2ad747), ruling 2: v5 promotes a three-seed recipe, not an average. The averaged model (c962cdd9) fails its own gate row: permutation_consistency 91.9%, 955 in-distribution abstentions against a cap of 504, and ood_abstain's suite half at 62/180.

ece_population.question: Should the ece gate run over all letter rows, with only its per-language breakdown requiring language metadata?
ece_population.value: the promotion population's letter rows (code.defect_class), per slot shape that family has; the per-language breakdown is report-only
ece_population.source: tools/real_ft_run.py calibration_states and language_eces as built
ece_population.decided_by: the human, by delegation ("For decisions ask fable and proceed with them", in the lead's session, 2026-10-03 ~13:14Z), through the lead, ruled by Fable
ece_population.decision_ref: AUDIT/finalize-2026-10-03/fable-delegated-decisions-ruling.md (main b2ad747), ruling 2: one population decision drives every in-distribution gate, and another ECE population would bring back the pooled base-rate objection that promotion_population rejects. Readings for code.defect_class k4 (bar 0.05): seed 0 0.0207, ens5 0.0135, avg 0.0498. The rejected readings: one pooled ECE over all 10,985 letter rows gives 0.0498, 0.0431 and 0.0578; per slot shape over every family fails k10 (intent.domain) at 0.081/0.099 and k15 (intent.within_domain) at 0.190/0.177. Takes effect only through code that reads this record (GAP-PROMOTION-RECORD-IS-NOT-APPLIED-BY-THE-GATES-2026-10-03).

degenerate_head_floor.question: Is the degenerate_head control's 0.15-nat entropy floor meaningful for a calibrated, near-certain head, on binary and four-way slots?
degenerate_head_floor.value: no predicted class above 0.95 of a slot shape's predictions, on every slot shape; the 0.15-nat mean-entropy floor is retired
degenerate_head_floor.source: python/qd_train/eval_harness.py DEFAULT_ENTROPY_FLOOR and DEFAULT_MAX_CLASS_SHARE as built
degenerate_head_floor.decided_by: the human, by delegation ("For decisions ask fable and proceed with them", in the lead's session, 2026-10-03 ~13:14Z), through the lead, ruled by Fable
degenerate_head_floor.decision_ref: AUDIT/finalize-2026-10-03/fable-delegated-decisions-ruling.md (main b2ad747), ruling 2. The floor penalises calibrated confidence, which is the model's design goal. ece measures whether confidence is earned, and the class-share bound catches the actual degeneracy, one class always. This is the one ruling that flips v4 verdicts: degenerate_head goes from fail to pass on ens5 (k2 entropy 0.1415, k16 0.1383), avg (k2 0.0956, k16 0.1312) and F seeds 1-4 (aeca8d69 k16 0.1337; 8c3a774a k2 0.0988, k16 0.1452; ebc83be6 k2 0.1433; d8c8300a k2 0.1252, k16 0.1474). Seed 0 passes either way. The largest top-class share on any slot of these seven rows is 0.517, against 0.95. No row promotes on this: every one still fails ood_abstain's suite half. Takes effect only through code that reads this record (GAP-PROMOTION-RECORD-IS-NOT-APPLIED-BY-THE-GATES-2026-10-03).
